task: Edit this fictional festival-news item against the supplied transcript and planning note. Repair the reversed meaning of the quotation, keeping any quoted wording accurate. In about 70–110 words, distinguish ticket sales from the festival itself and preserve what is still unknown. Disclose the consequential quotation correction separately.
input: The organisers have "cancelled the festival," a coordinator said. Advance tickets are no longer being sold because all venue arrangements have been abandoned. Sales will resume next week once a replacement event has been arranged.

facts.text: The supplied coordinator transcript says exactly: "We have paused advance ticket sales, not cancelled the festival."
The planning note says the festival programme is being revised.
The venue bookings remain in place.
No date has been given for advance sales to resume.

forbidden_additions: A cancelled festival, abandoned venue bookings, or an invented replacement event.
An altered quotation that drops or reverses the negation, or a claim of a new interview.
preserve: Paused advance sales distinguished from cancellation of the event.
The transcript's exact meaning and source attribution.
The unknown resumption date and a separate correction disclosure.
